errors.text_span: 旨在展示不同语体中“生活工作类”与“生理活动类”动词在二级语义域层面的分布情况，分为两个子图：(a) 展示“生活工作类”动词的分布，(b) 展示“生理活动类”动词的分布。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the topics of the subplots. The figure captions state they show the distribution of '支配动词' (dominant verbs) for (a) and '承受动词' (patient verbs) for (b), not '生活工作类' (life/work class) and '生理活动类' (physiological activity class).

The description completely omits the sub-categories on the x-axis. For each main category (e.g., '新闻'), there are two bars representing '男性' (male) and '女性' (female), which is a critical structural detail.
The description incorrectly names one of the x-axis categories as '网络文学' (Online Literature) when the chart label is '传统文学' (Traditional Literature).

errors.text_span: 在图(a)中，每个语体对应一个堆叠柱状图
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that each category on the x-axis corresponds to one stacked bar chart. In fact, each category has two stacked bars, one for '男性' (male) and one for '女性' (female).
The description provides examples of legend entries that do not appear in the chart's legend. The legend shows items like '参与 (4)', '赠与 (100)', etc.

The description incorrectly identifies the category with the lowest frequency in chart (a) as '新闻' (News). The category with the lowest frequency is '传统文学' (Traditional Literature), with totals of 16 and 14. The total for '新闻' is approximately 869, not 1000.
The description claims the '新闻' category is mainly composed of '工作' (work) and '管理' (management), but these semantic domains are not listed in the chart's legend.

errors.text_span: 在图(b)中，每个语体对应一个单一柱状图
errors.evidence: Similar to the error in chart (a), the description incorrectly states that each category in chart (b) has a single bar. Each category has two bars, for male and female.

The description incorrectly assigns values to categories in chart (b). The total for '新闻' (News) is 23+479=502, not 439. The value 5748 belongs to the female bar for '网络小说' (Online Novels), not '微博' (Weibo), which has a total frequency of only 27 (9+18).
The description incorrectly claims the legends for charts (a) and (b) are the same. They are two distinct legends with different categories and counts.

errors.text_span: 但“微博”在两类动词中均呈现显著高频
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the '微博' (Weibo) category shows high frequency in both charts. While it is high in chart (a), it has one of the lowest frequencies in chart (b) (total of 27).
